'''''Viola alba''''', commonly known as '''white violet''', is a species of violet in the family [[Violaceae]].

==Subspecies==
* ''Viola alba'' subsp. ''alba'' 
The native range of this subspecies is S. France to S. Poland and NW. Türkiye, W. Syria, however a there is a new record in Kashmir, India.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.researchgate.net |title=Viola alba subsp alba Violaceae a new record from the Kashmir Himalaya India |date=October 2025 |website=ResearchGate |access-date=2026-05-17}}</ref>
* ''Viola alba'' subsp. ''thessala''
* ''Viola alba'' subsp. ''alba scotophylla''
* ''Viola alba'' subsp. ''dehnhardtii''
